summary: Frontend-only test of the new TypeStats section on the Stats page (#/stats), run with the simulated Electron harness and a seed of 10 cards whose results I worked out by hand. Every requested check passed. ORDER and COLORS: type-stat-movies (sky-400), type-stat-tv (emerald-400), type-stat-docs (amber-400) and type-stat-anim (fuchsia-400) appear in that order. The 4 cards match the hand-computed values exactly. Movies: titles 4, hours ≈5.9, sub '4 files · 1 episodes · 62% real runtimes'. It contains a movie with runtime 120, a movie with no runtime (88 min estimate), a card outside any folder with runtime 100, and a tv card in D:\TVShows, which is set to movies (45 min estimate, does not leak into TV). TV: 3 titles, ≈5.9, '8 files · 5 episodes · 87% real runtimes'. It contains a 3-part card with episode runtimes 50, 50 and a double episode (number 3, last_number 4, runtime 90) = 190 min with 4 episodes, a 4-part card with card runtime 30 = 120 min known, and a single tv card with no runtime = 45 min estimate. Docs: 1 title, '25.0' with no ≈, 'hours · 1.0 days', '1 file · 100% real runtimes'. Anim: 2 titles, '≈103' (rounded at 100 h and above), 'hours · 4.3 days', '3 files · 97% real runtimes'. Regression: the top StatCards show 10 Total Movies and 5 Directories once CountUp finishes. Marathon Mode and the charts render, with no page errors. On the Library page, the category dropdown counts are Movies 3 (Movies 2, TVShows 1), TV 3, Docs 1 and Anime 2. Every 'All <cat>' item and the TVShows folder item filter correctly. qf-tv-shows shows the 4 tv cards. The inDir import into LocalLibraryPage works.

issues: Singular grammar: the sub line shows '1 episodes' when there is 1 episode. Files are handled correctly ('1 file').

A multi-part TV card with no TMDB episode objects (e.g. 4 parts, card runtime 30) adds 0 to the episode count, even though its minutes are counted as 4 x 30. Consider counting 1 episode per part when ep is missing and the card is TV.

Inconsistency (LOW): a card outside every registered folder counts as Movies in TypeStats (4 titles), but the Library 'Movies' dropdown says 3 because it only counts registered folders. This follows the spec, but users may notice the mismatch.

Marathon Mode still assumes ~88 min per movie for all items (15 h here), while TypeStats uses real runtimes (~140 h total here). The two figures contradict each other on the same page. Consider reusing cardMinutes.

action_items: Optional: pluralize 'episode' when the count is 1 in type-stat-{id}-sub.
Optional: count parts as episodes for TV multi-part cards that have no episode metadata.
Optional: align Marathon Mode hours with the TypeStats runtime math.
critical_code_review_comments: computeTypeStats reads localStorage on every render and is not memoized. This is fine at the current scale, but wrap it in useMemo([movies, directories]) for libraries with many thousands of cards.

When folders are nested (e.g. D:\TV and D:\TV\Kids), directories.find picks the first match in list order, not the most specific folder, so the category depends on the order folders were added. Prefer the longest matching dir.

cardMinutes uses the fallback `isTv || ep ? 45 : 88`, so a non-TV multi-part movie (CD1/CD2) is estimated at 88 min per part. That gives 176 min for a split movie, which is probably an overestimate. Consider treating the whole card as one 88 min movie.
seed_data_creation: Browser-only seed (sessionStorage fakeLibFile plus localStorage dirs and categories) in an isolated Playwright context. No app or DB data was touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/type_stats_harness.py: init_script() and EXPECTED (hand-computed values per category). Load it with sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tests') and page.context.add_init_script(h.init_script()), then go to #/stats. Wait about 4 s for the CountUp top cards to finish (they briefly show 9 and 4 while animating). Library cards have no movie-card-* testid in LocalLibraryPage, so match them by title text.
